segments.text:
V. 18.
He hath anointed me—With the Spirit. He hath by the Power of his Spirit which dwelleth in me, ſet me apart for theſe Offices. To preach the goſpel to the poor—Literally and ſpiritually.

How is the Doctrine of the ever-bleſſed Trinity interwoven, even in thoſe Scriptures where one would leaſt expect it? How clear a Declaration of the great Three-One is there in thoſe very Words, The Spirit—of the Lord—is upon Me! To proclaim deliverance to the captives, and recovery of ſight to the blind, to ſet at liberty them that are bruiſed—Here is a beautiful Gradation, in comparing the ſpiritual State of Men, to the miſerable State of thoſe Captives, who were not only caſt into Priſon, but, like Zedekiah, had their Eyes put out, and were laden and bruiſed with Chains of Iron.
